titleText: JTF News: BBC News, Deutsche Welle
mainText: Japan deployed fighter jets in response to a reported Russian airspace incursion.
Russian strikes hit bridges in Kyiv, according to the mayor of Kyiv.

titleText: JTF News: PBS NewsHour, BBC News
mainText: At least 17 people were killed in 2 shootings in South Africa on the same day.

titleText: JTF News: The Guardian, BBC News
mainText: Five European Union countries announced a migrant deportation centre in Rwanda.
The Federal Aviation Administration implemented a ground stop affecting thousands of flights, and President Trump met with President Xi Jinping of China and President Putin of Russia in Asia.
